# Composer form

`@kerfjs/ui:recipe-composer-form` · Kerf UI · production recipe · Recipes

## When to use

One visible publishing-form surface with Toolbar heading hierarchy, fields and actions on the shared 8px control gutter, 24px major rhythm, and a conditional StateBanner as its only nested semantic surface.

- A short form needs one coherent surface, consistent field/action rhythm, and persistent validation feedback.

**Not when:**

- Do not turn each form section into another visible card or use the recipe as a generic form engine or transport abstraction.

## Imports

- Nothing to import: this is a reference composition.
- Declared side effects: lazy-recipe-css, individual-custom-element-registration.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.
